meta.title: Advertise on YukSaroy
meta.description: Five ad places on the site: the bottom banner, two side rails and a block on the terminal and listing pages. File rules, what we count and the conditions, all on one page.

advertise.title: Advertise on the site
advertise.lead: YukSaroy is a freight marketplace: terminal owners, freight forwarders, cargo owners and carriers find each other here. For brands that sell equipment, services or financing to these people, the site has five ad places. Below: where each one appears, what file is needed, what gets counted and which conditions apply.

places.heading: Five places
places.lead: Two of them follow the whole site, three are drawn only on a specific page.
places.scroll: The table is wide: scroll it sideways.

bottom.name: Bottom banner
bottom.where: At the bottom of every public page. Visible on phones too.
bottom.size: An 8:1 image or muted video, for example 1200x150. On a computer it is 96 pixels tall; on a phone it takes no more than 22 percent of the screen. No heading and no text are drawn: the screen holds your file only.

left.name: Left side rail
left.where: To the left of every public page. Drawn only on screens wider than 1536 pixels.
left.size: A tall image or muted video: the rail is narrow, so wording inside a wide image would be unreadable. A heading and one line of text are drawn under the image.

right.name: Right side rail
right.where: To the right of every public page. Drawn only on screens wider than 1536 pixels.

terminal.name: Block on a terminal page
terminal.where: On a single terminal's own page, in the right column. It does not appear in the terminal list or on the home page.
terminal.size: An image or muted video, with a heading and one line of text under it.

listing.name: Block on a listing page
listing.where: On a single listing's own page, in the right column.
listing.size: Same as the terminal page block.

bottom.heading: The bottom banner and its three timings
bottom.lead: The bottom banner is the main place we sell, because people on phones see it too. It has three timings and each one has a reason.

delay.label: Appears after the page opens
delay.why: People first see what they came for. Shown at once, the banner blends into page loading and gets closed unread.

show.label: Stays on screen
show.why: Enough time to take the image in. Longer than that and the banner is in the way of reading. When the time is up it leaves on its own.

quiet.label: Does not return after being closed
quiet.why: That is at most twice a day per person. A banner that comes back the same day after being closed makes people leave the site.

bottom.note: The close button is 44x44 pixels and is never hidden. The banner is not a modal window: it does not take focus, and search, forms and menus keep working. On pages with a form (contact, cost estimate, request) and on the cargo status page the banner is not shown at all.
bottom.counted: A view of this banner is recorded only once it is actually on screen: during the delay it is not in the page at all.

files.heading: File requirements
files.lead: You send us the file, we do the placement.
files.types: Formats: jpg, png, webp, gif, mp4, webm. The type is checked from the file contents, not from the name: renaming the extension to send something else will not work.
files.size: 1.5 MB at most. A larger file is not accepted.
files.muted: Video always plays muted. An audio track, if there is one, is never heard.
files.prefer: Instead of an animated image (gif), send mp4 or webm: at the same quality the file is several times lighter.
files.host: The file sits on our own server. That means the browser makes no request to an outside address, and none of your script reaches the site.
files.lang: The wording lives inside the image, so you either give a separate file per language (uz, ru, en) or put one file on all three. That choice is yours.

counts.heading: What we count
counts.lead: We report three numbers and keep nothing else.

view.name: Views
view.body: Counted when the banner is actually on screen, not when it is added to the page. If a person never scrolled down, the block down there is not counted as seen.

click.name: Clicks
click.body: How many times the banner was clicked through to your site.

close.name: Closes
close.body: How many times the close button was pressed. We report this one too: if the close share is high, we shorten the display time or lengthen the quiet period.

counts.privacy: No third-party trackers, no pixels, no Google Analytics. What stays on the server is a daily aggregated number: no IP, no session, no page address. So there is no "which page it was clicked on" report either.

honest.heading: Conditions we state up front
honest.lead: These conditions reduce the number of views. We write them down here so there is no argument later.

subscribers.name: Subscribers are shown no ads
subscribers.body: A user with a paid subscription sees no banner in any of the five places. So the view count will be lower than the site's overall traffic.

rails.name: Side rails only on wide screens
rails.body: On screens narrower than 1536 pixels they are not drawn at all: we do not squeeze the content for a banner. Anyone on a phone will not see the side rails.

label.name: The "Ad" label cannot be removed
label.body: It sits next to every banner. We do not pass advertising off as the site's own content.

outside.name: After the click it is on you
outside.body: The link opens in a new tab and the person lands on your site. We are not answerable for what is there.

reject.heading: What we do not run
reject.lead: Such a banner is not accepted, and is taken down if it is already running.
reject.fakeClose: A fake close button or fake X inside the image.
reject.fakeUi: A fake search field, a fake play button, a fake system message.
reject.disguise: Anything dressed as part of the site, using our colours or our logo.
reject.sound: Video that turns sound on by itself.
reject.flash: More than three flashes per second, or a large area blinking sharply.
reject.restricted: Content unsuitable for minors, gambling, unlicensed lending.

cta.heading: Get in touch
cta.body: Tell us which place you need, which language it goes on and for how long you are planning. We will look at the file and reply.
cta.price: We do not print a price on this page: we agree it by place, duration and number of languages.
cta.note: In the contact form pick the "Partnership" topic.
